summary: Liminatus Pharma filed an 8-K disclosing entry into a merger agreement to acquire InnocsAI LLC via a reverse merger. Under terms, InnocsAI will merge into a new wholly-owned subsidiary; Liminatus will issue 1.6 billion shares of common stock at $0.20 per share as consideration, plus contingent value rights for 20% of future net proceeds from sale or out-license of acquired assets. The board implicitly approved the transaction; no advisor named. The filing notes a conflict of interest: CEO Chris Kim is controlling member of an InnocsAI member. The deal adds oncology CAR-T and antibody assets. Watch for Nasdaq listing compliance and shareholder vote timeline as risk-arb factors.
